name: menu
title: Menu
description: A vertical list of menu items with keyboard navigation. Used inside dropdowns, context menus and other popovers.

classes.name: menu__header
classes.description: A small heading for a group of items.

classes.name: menu__separator
classes.description: A divider between groups. Use it on an <hr>.

classes.name: menu__item
classes.description: A menu item. Combine it with btn.

classes.name: menu__item-key
classes.description: A keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the end of the item.

attributes.name: data-menu-target="item"
attributes.description: Items reachable with the arrow keys. Leave it off disabled items.

notes: Because the first item is focused whenever the menu becomes visible, put data-menu only on menus that start hidden, such as inside a popover.
Every time the menu becomes visible, its first item gets focus.
Arrow Down/Right move to the next item, Arrow Up/Left to the previous one (mirrored in right-to-left layouts), and Home/End jump to the first/last item.
Only the active item is in the tab order (tabindex=0); the rest get tabindex=-1.
